   DATE:        March 4, 1991
   SUBJECT:     Allowable Allowances in applying the Building
                Code / Zoning Resolution Requirements


   PURPOSE:

   To clarify the Department's existing procedure regarding
   allowances in applying the Building Code and / or Zoning
   Resolution.
   SPECIFICS:

   The Department has the authority in administering and
   enforcing the Building Code, Zoning Resolution and other
   applicable laws to permit allowances of a reasonable degree.
   Per the attached memoranda from Commissioner Rudolph
   Rinaldi, the allowances will continue on a case-by-case
   basis by the Borough Commissioner/ Superintendent or of the
   Deputy Borough Superintendent and shall be reasonable.
